verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Honeycomb acting as an MCP server that external agents connect to, plus Canvas skills that add instructions or context. That is the server role and an adjacent feature, not Honeycomb consuming external MCP servers' tools. Honeycomb has in-product AI investigation (Canvas), so this client-side axis plausibly applies, but nothing shows Honeycomb can plug in third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
